cases.customer_question: How should the DUT be connected to the InterLab system for RF PHY testing when control from InterLab does not work?
cases.actual_issue: Incorrect physical test setup and uncertainty about whether a PC should act as a UART bridge between the DUT and the InterLab system.
cases.consultant_answer: The consultant explained that, based on the customer material, the PC was likely not intended to act as a bridge between the DUT and InterLab. Instead, the InterLab USB should be connected in place of the PC in the DUT-to-PC connection described by the customer. A cross cable should only be used in special cases where a chipset architecture explicitly requires a PC bridge, such as certain Qualcomm-based setups. For a normal DUT-to-InterLab configuration, that cross-cable bridge setup should not be used.
cases.final_recommendation: Reconnect the setup so that InterLab USB replaces the PC in the DUT connection path. Do not use the cross-cable PC bridge unless the chipset architecture explicitly requires a PC bridge.
